originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The reviewed planes reference preserves different-authority maps and explicitly adopts no master topology. Source spells still name Material/Ethereal or another plane.
originalQuestions.options: A: source-linked campaign plane/site records with a separately authored, minimal mechanical correspondence only where this particular effect needs it. B: declare a universal co-spatial Ethereal border or equate original realms, Wheel labels and website shells.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Identify exactly which new operational records each spell requires and the authority for their existing names. Do not invent missing lore, plane equivalence, Heartcell authorship, native origin or soul jurisdiction. A local mechanical mapping must be explicitly new and bounded, not recovered canon. If a needed named relationship has no support, retain that branch as a declared hold and say precisely what remains missing. Successful GitHub preservation permits this careful conference; it does not approve a new topology.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original: randomly phase between Material and Ethereal. Core: Action, range60, Instantaneous, V/S/M-or-F, rank3 cost5. The existing reviewed representation is explicitly nonoperative receipt only.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly choose a single willing recipient within the printed60, finite duration and exact random departure/return schedule. B: replace range60 with Self or import an external die threshold and automatic turn-start return.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Request an explicit useful native completion, preserving60 as a real selection parameter unless an expressly justified conflict decision changes it. Decide caster-only versus another recipient, consent and any resistance. A random episode requires a finite lifetime, the exact probability distribution, named eligible event, stable RNG identity and handling of a denied/suppressed opportunity. Do not retroactively call the old receipt operative or copy Blink Step, which is a distinct post-hit local Reaction. Ordinary RNG does not add a sixth disclosed Fate presentation.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A phased character is still one real body with real equipment, concentration, injuries and a live clock; no corresponding-coordinate rule is printed.
originalQuestions.options: A: a bounded explicitly authored spell-specific entry/return mapping with actual supported occupied volumes. B: general pass-through-walls, immunity, omniscience, tactical free return placement or a new canonical plane generated by analogy to Banishment.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose exact Material/Ethereal origin eligibility, entry pose, orientation, velocity/fall history, senses and permitted interaction while absent, with carried gear and separately carried creatures. Preserve actual class turns/attached phases and all clocks across absence. Specify whether movement in Ethereal changes return location; any such correspondence is a new bounded rule requiring a complete model. Do not borrow Banishment cell growth, half-matter, automatic safe air, cross-plane sensing or attack permissions. A missing mapping is a declared whole positive-case hold.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Returning on expiry, suppression, dispel, death or an obstructed old location can strand a body or bypass wards.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly define ordinary periodic return and mandatory final closure separately, each with finite actual placement/blocker behavior. B: assume all return ignores transport wards because Banishment terminal return does.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select exact transport classification and voluntary predicate for both directions. Address existing Dimensional Anchor, No Escape, Verdict Absolute, Reign of Ashes and source-specific planar barriers only within their actual predicates. Any override of endpoint prevention is a new Blink-only decision, not inherited BAN-CLOSE-03 authority. State what ends when recipient/caster dies, changes plane by another lawful source, or a suppression sphere clips the real body. No queued extra phase, healed duplicate, spatial bisection or indefinite avoidance of an ended effect. Recast policy must prevent duration/RNG resets without a paid new cast.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Current source name is Veiled Chest, hide chest in Ethereal. There is no exact-name Core entry; Leomund's Secret Chest is only a possible historical alias with Action/60/Instantaneous/VSF.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly choose whether those proposed activation fields are new corroborated completions while preserving both identities. B: automatically merge the alias or import an external miniature chest, gold price and loss timetable.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Return a separate reasoned identity/metadata disposition and a full native cast envelope. The printed effect moves an actual chest; it does not print creation of a free chest or a private demiplane. Choose actual permitted chest count, dimensions/mass/capacity, open/closed state, custody and carried/anchored eligibility. Cite the existing equipment chest if used; do not assign every chest the same invented physical profile.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Real contents enter named Ethereal storage, but the source supplies no destination, persistence, recall, retrieval cost or life-support rule.
originalQuestions.options: A: a finite bounded named-Ethereal storage/recall procedure with exact retrieval action/resource and real endpoint. B: indefinitely free inaccessible inventory, arbitrary remote item retrieval or a Banishment cell renamed Ethereal.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select the duration and record identity, actual destination relation, owner/authorized retriever, retrieval distance and cost, one-active/replacement behavior and what succeeds on a failed new cast. State whether living creatures/corpses/other containers may be inside and what that means for independent creature eligibility, breath, food, weather, cargo clocks and carried capacity. Contents retain identity, quantity, provenance and real internal containment; storage is neither cleansing nor duplication. Explicit exclusions are new local limits to justify, not physiology inferred from being unseen.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Dispel/suppression, death, unavailable destination and source wards can intersect a stored physical object.
originalQuestions.options: A: a complete finite retrieval/closure conflict procedure which retains the same chest and every item. B: silent item deletion, automatic arrival in occupied matter, universal ward bypass or frozen decay/campaign time.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Request exact locus for suppression of remote chest versus local link, destination placement and failed retrieval, stolen/replaced token if any, owner death, chest destruction and contents liberation. Decide whether terminal closure differs from voluntary retrieval and state any chosen exception expressly. No unprinted damage die, infinite inventory search, hidden-place diagnostic or generic reset of all transported effect durations. Actual accepted cargo/settlement obligations persist.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Source: portal to another plane for1minute; Action60, VSF, rank5 cost10. Alignment Portal is bidirectional physical planar travel, while Faction Portal is one-way teleport transit with different movement/knowledge rules.
originalQuestions.options: A: choose one complete native Gate model preserving60-second usefulness and explicitly state concentration, aperture sizes/poses, directionality and sight/sound/line-of-effect. B: silently combine the most favorable properties of the two accepted portals.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with exact source-specific transport classification. Distinguish origin casting range60 from destination distance, actual known plane/site and recorded receiving pose. Specify who can use an aperture, voluntary/forced movement, real carried creatures/items, loose objects/fluids/projectiles and fit/support. A gateway can be useful without authorizing remote attacks or free portal geometry; choose those properties explicitly. Actual No Escape/teleport-only blockers/Anchor and Planar Protection apply after the chosen classification.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A1minute gateway can be repeatedly crossed, suppressed or closed while travelers remain on the far side.
originalQuestions.options: A: finite exact crossing transactions with all-body admission, current destination checks and defined failure costs. B: backdated crossing, split bodies/cargo or invented guaranteed rescue after closure.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select known-illegal versus hidden/new-failure commitment behavior; Faction Portal and Alignment Portal differ, so neither is a global default. Give deterministic supported destination selection without remote tactical search, one-source replacement rules and actual source/endpoint suppression. State deadline equality and whether an already legally committed crossing finishes atomically. Gate expiration supplies no automatic return unless explicitly chosen; prevent indefinite half-transit and do not make a destination rumor into a discovery oracle.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Illusion: enter Ethereal with up to10 willing creatures. Transmutation: enter Ethereal. Both Action120InstantaneousVSF. Actual classes use different schools; Wizard's access is Illusion, not free choice.
originalQuestions.options: A: preserve two complete profiles and explicitly resolve participant count and caster inclusion for each. B: merge into a common ten-target power or erase range120 with an imported Self profile.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. State whether the ten are companions in addition to the caster or total recipients, whether Transmutation is caster-only or one selected recipient, and the actual local range/LoE/consent gates. Use the real class-access row for the school: Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard Illusion, Druid/Mage/Shaman Transmutation. A printed second placement alone grants no acquisition. Clearly label every new count decision and retain original wording.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Instantaneous plane entry does not itself promise free eventual return, incorporeality, ordinary-world sight, flight or unlimited terrain traversal.
originalQuestions.options: A: actual residence with an explicitly chosen bounded ongoing travel/return spell effect. B: true instantaneous one-way transport requiring another lawful return; or another fully specified model.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must select a useful source-faithful model rather than assuming external duration. Specify finite lifetime/concentration if added, independent recipient separation, exact senses and interactions with beings/objects on each plane, true movement/support, breathing/environment and permitted return mapping. A plane name does not make all barriers permeable or generate a paired world. If these properties need new named-plane lore, identify the precise dependency rather than invent it inside spell text.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Multiple travelers may die, lose concentration, suppress separately, change form or move to different destinations before the spell ends.
originalQuestions.options: A: exact per-recipient lifetime and group closure model with original body/gear identity and bounded placement. B: sharing one caster silently makes all travelers immune to local blockers or gives each a free bespoke return.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Decide recipient early-ending action, loss of one traveler/caster, separated planes, local suppression, original placement collisions and terminal return treatment. Distinguish source-global ending from clipped recipient benefits. Actual Fallen/Downed/dead state remains; no revival, duplicated equipment, paused concentration or copied action history. Any terminal-ward exception must be explicit and source-specific. Preserve distinct conditional tests for both school profiles.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both placements transport up to8 willing creatures to another plane; Action120InstantaneousVSF rank7 cost17. Every current eligible class maps to Conjuration.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicit origin recipients within120 and one previously known real destination plane/site, with a chosen local placement method. B: freely choose an unknown vault/true home plane or add external tuning-fork material/hostile banishment mode.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Resolve whether caster counts among8 and whether caster must travel; include the complete actual group, independently carried creatures, real container/cargo custody and every creature consent. Preserve Transmutation source text as ungranted alternate placement unless a legitimate route exists. No soul/origin/native plane inferred from appearance, alignment or a creature type.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Source gives no precision, mishap, group failure, return or ward-overriding policy.
originalQuestions.options: A: source-local atomic group relocation to a bounded supported destination chosen from documented site data. B: a declared native scatter/mishap model or per-recipient split outcome.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A for review, with exact finite search region, neutral tie order and occupancy/real volume/support checks. Explicitly select teleportation versus non-teleport planar classification; classification changes the real Paladin blockers. Define prepayment known failures and nondiagnostic postcommit hidden failures, with no automatic refund or concentration restoration. An instantaneous successful journey should retain resulting body history and provide no automatic return or later suppression rewind unless expressly authored. Planar Protection prospective-arrival provenance requires a source-specific extension, not a global origin label.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Source transports creatures to a distant location; Action120InstantaneousVSF rank7 cost17.120 is not an established maximum travel distance.
originalQuestions.options: A: same-plane, explicitly bounded known-site distant relocation with new finite target count/consent and recipient range120. B: external familiarity table, arbitrary unseen coordinate oracle or secretly cross-plane travel.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Preserve a meaningful distant-travel benefit: decide distance ceiling or no geographic ceiling within the same actual plane, destination evidence requirements and allowable precision. Choose whether caster must travel/count, how separately carried creatures count, and actual belongings limits. Reliable knowledge must identify a physical site, not just a name; remote sensing supplies only information it actually obtained. Same-plane scope is a new local choice, not a statement that every named source teleport has that restriction.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Hidden destination occupancy and wards can reveal private facts or split the selected group.
originalQuestions.options: A: one atomic actual group transaction with exact bounded placement and nondiagnostic paid failure. B: explicit native scatter/mishap or individual outcomes with their own complete consequence table.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A; specify actual footprint/height/orientation, support, stationary versus moving intended sites, known/hidden origin and destination blockers and neutral tie order. Retain real on-arrival hazards and concentration/health clocks without replaying already completed events. Ordinary teleport-only Paladin restrictions matter; Forbiddance has no generic travel prohibition. No return rope, time-free resting, cloned cargo or inferred new plane identity. A pure displacement with no damage has no invented Null damage root.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Current plane prose supplies no general numerical clock conversion; Opening2400hours/Horn1200hours are actual existing clocks, with campaign epoch unresolved.
originalQuestions.options: A: explicitly require actual adopted operational time metadata; use a newly stated spell-limited equal-elapsed-time rule only for the bounded authored travel model if needed. B: infer no time passes or arbitrary fast rests from an Astral/Ethereal name.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select the minimal workable rule and label its scope. No automatic mapping of primordial ages to dungeon cycles, rest/resource refresh, pause of durations/food/injury/Hunt clocks or changed campaign epoch. A campaign place already having an explicit adopted time rule retains it; if the travel model cannot reconcile that rule, declare the branch unsupported pending a complete conversion. Existing Expedition actual-arrival/Extraction/custody requirements remain: transport may bypass a route leg but does not settle cargo, taxes, credentials or the Opening. This question concerns new travel time behavior, not reopening ordinary cast pricing or the established combat clock.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: A map relation must be an actual operational object, not the word Ethereal.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Specify input/output plane identities, coordinate frames and units, bounded domain, pose/orientation/velocity rule, size/shape/cargo transform (identity unless expressly chosen), inverse/return applicability, invalidation, environment/support, and time conversion. A one-way relationship is not automatically invertible. If a moving body leaves the map domain, or a separately lawful spell takes it to a third plane, select exact future pulse/return behavior. The author may demonstrate explicitly NEW synthetic site facts without claiming original cosmology proves them; retain a concrete campaign deployment hold for unavailable real mappings. Unknown mapping must not be mistaken for a hidden occupied destination, because the caster has not supplied a legal destination designation at all.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: Terminal settlement has a different collision problem from an ordinary failed journey.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Show three separately bounded branches: ordinary optional transit blocked at origin, a mandatory scheduled/terminal return blocked only by magical endpoint prevention, and a mandatory return with every candidate physical volume occupied. Specify whether the effect ends with actual residents remaining where they are, reserves a real supported return place, or supplies a narrowly explicit settlement exception. Do not borrow BAN-CLOSE-03 or silently broaden any field. If complete body settlement is not possible under the chosen rule, retain the entire dependent positive case as unfulfilled; a generic stays safe or nearest safe square assertion cannot pass. Resolve death/remains, source removal while suppressed, simultaneous deadline and return, and leaving by independent lawful transport exactly once.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: Randomness must not become free fishing, a retroactive dodge, or a sixth Fate result.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Choose a native random-event distribution and actual event identity. Demonstrate two same-time duplicate deliveries, normal missed opportunity, suppression spanning a scheduled roll, and a new source replacing the old one. State whether randomness is consumed on a blocked attempt and whether voluntary consent is tested at every optional pulse; random outcome alone does not decide the No Escape voluntary predicate. A declared attack must finish under its actual source event order before any later periodic transition; the spell cannot reroll or erase the attack by retrospectively selecting an earlier phase.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: The selected coherent chest and its contents form an identity and custody graph.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Bind an actual equipment profile, empty and loaded mass/Load, dimensions/interior/capacity, closure and attachment state, full contents with unique identities, all independent custodians, and a real ethereal destination. Account separately for living passenger, dead remains, transformed creature-origin object and nested chest. A transformed person is not automatically noncreature cargo; a closed box is not proof it contains no creature. Choose what is eligible before payment and how private contents can produce a nondiagnostic paid failure. If a chest breaks after storage, name the actual fragments/content positions and legal recall target; do not recreate the original chest or ignore another actual holder. Suppression of a link does not itself delete or materialize physical residents.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: A gate requires complete two-sided geometry and transaction boundaries.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Bind fixed entrance and exit bases, usable aperture shape/thickness, corresponding front/back faces, and exact rigid body/cargo transform. Demonstrate a long rigid carried beam that fits the opening but cannot turn or fit the exit receiving volume; portal formation clearance alone is insufficient. A shared carried creature belongs to one atomic actual group, counted separately for predicates. State independent physical object/fluid/projectile behavior as well as creatures. At exact expiry choose a stable total order between a prior committed whole crossing and closure; no occupant may be cut in half. Resolve a containing platform moving or breaking after fixed placement without silently moving the mouth.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: A participant count is over unique actual creature identities, not carrier roots or tokens.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Give a boundary-count case in each selected group profile: exactly the permitted number, one additional carried passenger, and duplicate/shared membership in the cargo graph. Caster inclusion/necessity, independent consent, local range, source-target line of effect and actual access school must be complete. For Illusion Etherealness distinguish 10 total versus caster plus10 by an explicit NEW choice. Transmutation needs its own complete acquired class example; a Wizard13 Illusion example cannot stand in. Plane Shift retains its ungranted Transmutation placement but has no actual Transmutation access case. Cases do not grant spells to all members merely because one caster can cast.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: Bounded placement must preserve useful distant travel without hidden-site search.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Define the exact candidate poses and a finite neutral order before resolution; full-height body/cargo and group interpenetration checks apply to each candidate. A failed private occupancy check cannot disclose wall/ward/type/plane cause. Compare a fixed world site with a moving deck represented by its own frame: choose whether a previously observed moving frame qualifies and what stale knowledge means. An arrival 500 miles away does not require 500 miles of line of effect; the native120ft applies to the selected local bodies unless explicitly changed. Conversely a known destination name alone is not full coordinates/fit knowledge. All failed paid casts retain real class resources and history; successful pure displacement creates no damage root.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: Time metadata must reconcile creature-local life clocks and campaign clocks.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: Supply a concrete elapsed-time ledger through departure, residence, return and initiative changes: resource history, Dying/Stable deadlines, disease/Decay/food, ongoing concentration, duration expiry, Opening2400h and Horn1200h continue under their own actual source. If equal elapsed time is newly selected for these bounded examples, state it as a spell-local fixture assumption; do not override an independently adopted place-time rule. Demonstrate a conflicting known place-time relation as an unsupported complete branch, not an implicit pause. Pact Hunt state remains real and no plane journey creates a routine resurrection exception.

additionalFocusedQuestions.finding: Arrival provenance is an operational record, not origin/soul knowledge.
additionalFocusedQuestions.request: For actual cross-plane transitions explicitly select the narrow prospective-origin extension before checking Planar Protection, then update lastArrivedFromPlaneKey only on successful completion. A failed journey must preserve old provenance. Same-plane Teleport must not fabricate cross-plane arrival history. Planar Barrier needs its own actual affirmative classification and geometry; a visitor is not automatically native or extraplanar. Forbiddance applies its actual alignment-damage entry contract, never a generic travel ban. Supply separately the real predicates and actual acquired sources for Anchor, No Escape, Verdict and Reign; a spell-name matrix without native sources is insufficient.

caseObligations.obligation: Actual acquired rank3 class actor, ordinary legal cast, selected random schedule with both phase outcomes, actual site relation and matching whole body/cargo geometry; show full departure/residence/return state and a later paid unrelated action.

Countered/known-illegal/hidden destination and source-suppression branches; duplicate random event; mandatory final closure with occupied return and separately magical blocker; preserve historical receipt as nonoperation only.

Actual real chest at exact capacity with complete ordinary cargo, all holders consenting, legal storage, real duration elapsed and real action/cost recall into supported whole volume; each item exists exactly once throughout.

Hidden disallowed living/transformed cargo, remote third-party custody, physical chest breakage, link suppression, owner death and expiration; unchanged unsupported branches are qualified rather than replaced by simple empty-box success.

Actual different plane and known site, legal mouths and explicit native classification, paid casting then real movement of two travelers in distinct events including carried cargo; current occupancy changes before second crossing.

Long beam/group fit counterexample, actual endpoint ward and forced/voluntary distinction, exact deadline atomic order, local suppression and real traveler remaining after closure; no rescue assumption.

Actual Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard Illusion access, explicit maximum-count roster including caster choice, complete willing recipients and their personal cargo, defined cross-plane site relation and chosen actual residence/return model.

One extra carried passenger, one blocked member and an explicitly separated traveler; local benefit suppression versus source end, death/remains, blocked return and independently departed recipient with no duplicate extraction.

Actual Druid/Mage/Shaman acquired Transmutation access and full class costs/acquisition; selected self/one-target interpretation, genuine usable origin selection120ft if retained, complete legal residence under chosen model.
Unsupported target or site, actual counter and suppression, mandatory/optional return distinction and exact actor lifecycle; no imported ten-companion scope and no Wizard alternate-school shortcut.

Actual acquired Conjuration access, exact8 boundary roster under selected caster rule, unique IDs/cargo, genuinely known different site and finite arrival poses, all real origin/destination predicates and successful provenance.

Ninth carried passenger before payment, hidden single-recipient arrival block after paid commitment, all-or-nothing return of state, real prospective Planar Protection and persistent old provenance on failure; no automatic return after successful instantaneous travel.

Actual acquired Universal access and explicitly selected meaningful distant same-plane destination, full maximum roster/cargo, neutral finite pose search, exact support and one real later on-arrival hazard/event with its native source.

Known local range/consent failure, stale moving-destination knowledge, private occupancy/ward paid failure and unchanged cross-plane provenance; actual Forbiddance versus teleport-only blocker predicates and no imaginary traversed path.

authorityBoundary: All six require complete initial authoring; no prior authored procedure is silently selected. The old Blink receipt is not a success case.

Original cosmology first with exact owner corrections. HEARTCELL_OWNER_UPDATE_02 and Q6_LATER_LOCK_REVIEWED_01 supersede narrower historical wording; no builder, identity, topology, epoch or revelation invention.
Time5 and Body8 are now accepted/applied; Transport6 remains unaccepted. Do not derive a generic transport standard from its current draft.

New synthetic encounter/site facts may make authored cases concrete only when explicitly labeled; unavailable genuine campaign mapping remains a separate precise hold. Do not claim source authentication from internal arithmetic.
